en.headline: John Catlin wins Hong Kong Open by five shots at Fanling
en.dek: The American closed with a six-under 64 to finish at 20 under, while local player Matthew Cheung tied for second in the best finish by a Hong Kong golfer in the event’s history.
body: American John Catlin claimed the 2026 Link Hong Kong Open on Sunday with a five-shot victory at the Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling.

Starting the final round tied for the lead at 14 under, Catlin carded a six-under-par 64 to finish at 20 under overall. Hong Kong’s Matthew Cheung and Finland’s Kalle Samooja shared second place at 15 under. Cheung’s result is the best finish ever by a local player in the tournament’s 65-year history.

The win is Catlin’s seventh Asian Tour title and his first since the 2024 Saudi Open. It also earned him an invitation to next year’s Masters and a place in The Open at St Andrews. Catlin described the result as a dream come true after years of work.
The US$2 million Asian Tour event concluded on the Composite Course. Jazz Janewattananond of Thailand and Nick Voke of New Zealand finished tied for fourth at 14 under.

zh.headline: 美國選手卡特林以五桿優勢贏得香港公開賽
zh.dek: 他決賽日打出低於標準六桿的64桿，總成績低於標準二十桿；本地球員張雄熙並列亞軍，創港將歷來最佳成績。
body: 美國選手約翰·卡特林周日在粉嶺香港高爾夫球會贏得2026年Link香港公開賽，以五桿優勢奪冠。
卡特林決賽日前以低於標準十四桿並列領先，最終打出低於標準六桿的64桿，總成績低於標準二十桿。香港球員張雄熙與芬蘭的卡勒·薩穆亞並列亞軍，成績為低於標準十五桿。張雄熙的成績是這項賽事65年來香港球員的最佳成績。
這是卡特林第七個亞巡賽冠軍，亦是他自2024年沙特公開賽以來的首個亞巡冠軍。優勝同時為他帶來明年美國名人賽邀請及聖安德魯斯英國公開賽資格。卡特林形容結果是多年努力後的夢想成真。
這項獎金總額200萬美元的亞巡賽在綜合球場完結。泰國的賈斯·詹納瓦塔納農與紐西蘭的尼克·沃克並列第四，成績低於標準十四桿。
